purpose: User-requested native MuJoCo straight, tension-only tendon trial

tendon.interpretation: Unilateral native soft maximum-length constraint, not the old10N/m and2Ns/m elastic law; constraint may have small solver compliance. Straight and massless, no sag.

initialization: Keep original randomized initial states; no projection or hidden height/rope-length adjustment. Initial stretch can excite the native soft constraint and is included.
safety: Original offline limits; native tension also checked at all physics substeps, not only the100Hz endpoints
